📰 Neuromorphic Chips: Tiny Sparks, Big Learning

Neuromorphic computing mimics brain-like learning using sparse spike-based signals instead of dense clock-driven operations. This shift enables ultra-low-power AI inference on edge devices, reducing reliance on cloud compute for real-time decisions.

📅 30 Oct 2026 | Source: Intel Museum / Semiconductor Manufacturing Principles
